notes.title: V1.13 - community requests update
notes.content:
Update includes:
-Slightly less punishing Killbots
-Abort game command (with confirmation timer)
-Fullscreen option in options page
-Improved steam overlay performance (hopefully)
-Corrected typo
-Friends or global high score leaderboards
-Sorry no game length option yet
-Main menu quit button - Quitting has never been easier!
